_meta.units: camera-RGB normalised to THIS panel's own black=0 / white=255 - NOT sRGB
do_not_use: bench-eink/panel_profile.jsonl (mixes two alignment regimes across 48/119 rows)
_meta.sigma_definition: 1 standard deviation of a SINGLE measurement, pooled within groups of bit-identical renders where available
_meta.mdd_definition: minimum detectable difference between two single measurements, 95% two-sided = 2.8 * sigma

headline_rule.text: Compare AGGREGATES, never single steps or single cells. Per-step/per-cell differences up to 143/255 were measured between BIT-IDENTICAL renders.

tonefine._basis: pooled within 6 identical-render groups (wp,gamma), 36 rows, 30 df; saturation and chroma-gamma are bit-identical no-ops on a neutral target (verified digitally, max pixel diff 0)

steps_anisotropy_single.verdict: heavy-tailed; use the median over steps, never a single step

huevalue._basis: 4 centre replicates (they share one alignment) x 1.45 inflation transferred from the tonefine measurement of the alignment lottery; the factor is an ESTIMATE, not a measurement

undithered._basis: primaries#1 vs primaries#2, two separate refreshes 46 s apart

ink_field_509x345.note: worst is green alone; every other ink <= 4

invalid_fields._reason: instrument defect #8 - the calibration strip is sampled at nominal coordinates on the ALIGNED image, which has been displaced to register the CONTENT
fields: readout.spread / readout.sd / readout.centre_out on the two surround rows
gain and offset in any re-derived row (stale, carried from the in-run record)

randomisation.rule: A white-point effect estimated ONLY from rows 3-14 or 18-29 carries an illumination-drift term. Confirm it against the block-2 rows, where wp 0.0/0.64/0.75/0.88/1.0 all recur in randomised order. gamma, chroma and saturation are not aliased anywhere.

time_dependence.verdict: Use ONE error bar for the whole session. Readout error is alignment-dominated, not photon-dominated.

excluded_rows.reason: affine failed, gain 255000 (panel rotated 180, strip sampled upside down)
excluded_rows.recoverable: rotate the RAW 180 before rectifying -> gain [2.51,2.59,2.64], residual 12.26; with flat_final.png -> [2.65,2.46,2.52], residual 11.45

issues: value_in labels are WRONG: readout hard-codes 40..245; the render used --v-lo 20 --v-hi 100 so true inputs are 20/36/52/68/84/100
corrected with the pre-rotation flat; their correct flat is flat_final.png
alignment reference rebuilt at the default v-range, so it does not match the render
scoped_rows.use: within-block white-point comparison only; do not pool with the other huevalue rows

offline_improvement_available.how: force each KIND's median (scale,dx,dy) as align_prior in cmd_rederive
offline_improvement_available.note: NOT applied - A1_rederived.jsonl is the standard re-derive and the shipped sigmas describe it as it stands

alignment.not_fully_fixable: even at the best alignment the ramp reaches 19.2/25, not 25/25; ~23% of the wobble is non-global distortion the homography cannot report
